## How I built it

- **Data**: where it came from and how you cleaned it (Power Query steps, joins).
- **Model**: star schema, key relationships.
- **Measures**: one or two DAX measures worth showing.

```dax
Revenue YoY % =
DIVIDE ( [Revenue] - [Revenue LY], [Revenue LY] )
```
